system.description: Working in her laboratory upon a willing subject, the biothaumaturge can increase a body's regenerative prowess. Once per evening, for every Mental Trait spent (up to three), one wound level is converted to a lesser type: aggravated becomes lethal, lethal becomes bashing, and bashing vanishes entirely. The surgery takes about 10 minutes per wound level reduced, and the spent Mental Traits cannot be regained until the next evening, even with Willpower.
